metric.definition: The share of facility consumption matched by renewable generation, reported either as annual matching through purchased certificates or as around-the-clock hourly matching.

reading.body:
Renewable energy utilization measures the share of a facility's power consumption matched by renewable generation, reported either as annual matching through purchased certificates or as around-the-clock hourly matching.

These are described as very different claims, with hourly carbon-free matching being the harder standard that the largest operators are now reporting progress against, which means a single renewable percentage figure can conceal whether a facility is actually running on clean power at 3 a.m. or is simply buying enough annual certificates to offset a mostly fossil-fueled grid draw on paper. Reading which claim is being made is described as mattering more than the percentage itself.

Its siblings, Water Usage Effectiveness and Carbon Usage Effectiveness, are grouped under Sustainability, and together they represent the three resource dimensions, energy sourcing, water, and carbon, that sustainability reporting for data centers is now built around.
